title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, from Crystal Dynamics and Amazon Games, is due on Switch 2 on February 12, 2027. The US eShop's pre-release estimate is 58.6 GB, which would make it one of the larger Switch 2 installs: almost a quarter of the console's 256 GB of storage. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so the box gives you a key and the whole game downloads. No official resolution or frame-rate figures for Switch 2 have been published yet. We will add the final size and performance once they are confirmed.
